anchor.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production achievement icon for Monster Slam, a friendly fantasy vocabulary game for children/teens. Style reference: the four supplied game assets (polished dimensional painted fantasy, rich colors, soft bevels, strong clean silhouette). Square 1024x1024 image. A magnificent compact stone castle with EXACTLY FOUR clearly visible towers with blue flags, bathed in a luminous protective aura. Castle large, centered, light warm stone against dark royal blue radial gradient, a few magic sparkles. Bright light upper left. Simplified bold forms readable at 56px. Steam achievement tile: background painted opaque all the way to a narrow beveled GOLD metal frame inset at the very outer perimeter, frame width about 4% of tile, rounded square corners radius 10% of width. Frame itself belongs to image, flush to canvas edges. Only outside rounded corners is transparent. No surrounding padding. No text, no lettering, no digits, no numbers, no watermark. Friendly premium game art, strong value separation for grayscale. Output actual transparent corner alpha.

atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite ATLAS for Monster Slam Steam-like achievements. Landscape canvas exact 3:2 ratio, ideally 1536x1024 or 2304x1536. EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equally sized SQUARE cells, six icons, no gutters, no margins, no labels. Cell boundaries at x=0,1/3,2/3,1 and y=0,1/2,1. Each icon fills its cell edge to edge, its own opaque colored painted backdrop and narrow rounded square beveled metallic perimeter frame, consistent width 3.5% of cell and corner radius 10%. Transparency ONLY outside each frame's rounded corners, nowhere inside tiles. Use reference image ONLY as style/lighting/frame construction reference. Polished dimensional painted fantasy game icons, rich saturated colors, soft bevels, friendly for children/teens. Each tile ONE bold central motif fills ~75% of cell, large simple chunky silhouette. Upper left light; bright motif against darker background, readable at 56px and in grayscale. Fewer details than reference castle. Small background glow and restrained sparks. ABSOLUTELY NO text, letters, numerals, numbers, words, labels, watermarks, runes, fake writing or question marks anywhere including books and maps. Square tiles must stay separate, no objects cross cell boundaries. Order left to right across first row, then left to right across second row:
CELL 1 (TOP LEFT): A cute little green monster with a LARGE round sniffing nose leans over an open blank book, two tiny pawprints; BRONZE frame, warm dark green background.
CELL 2 (TOP CENTER): One bow and arrow, arrow piercing one flying blank book page; SILVER frame, sky blue background.
CELL 3 (TOP RIGHT): Cute small orange dragon curled up on a hoard of chunky closed books; GOLD frame, ember red/orange background.
CELL 4 (BOTTOM LEFT): Large friendly fierce purple monster roaring with several blank book pages swirling around; DIAMOND crystal frame, violet sparkle background.
CELL 5 (BOTTOM CENTER): One little seedling growing out of an open blank book; BRONZE frame, spring green background.
CELL 6 (BOTTOM RIGHT): Tall stack of thick colorful books with a large golden bookmark and shine; GOLD frame, deep blue background.

atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a CORRECTION ATLAS of exactly THREE square achievement tiles in ONE horizontal row, aspect 3:1, no gutters, no margins, ideally 1536x512 or 2304x768. Reference image 1 (castle): match polished dimensional Monster Slam painting, upper left illumination, narrow beveled frame width 3.5%, rounded corners radius10%, background opaque to frame, transparency outside rounded corners only. Reference image2 purple medal: reference for medallion disks and downward swallowtail ribbons, not tile framing. NO text, NO letters, NO digits, NO numbers, NO pseudo writing anywhere. Large simple bright silhouette over darker saturated backgrounds, readable at56px.
LEFT square: cute green little monster with a LARGE round nose leaning down to SNIFF an open BLANK book; include TWO plainly visible small golden PAW PRINTS in foreground beside book, bronze frame, warm dark green gradient, soft magical glow. Nose almost touches blank book.
CENTER square: partly rolled parchment treasure map, SEVERAL little castle pictograms, winding dashed treasure route ending at a small RED DIAMOND SHAPED GEM pictogram, small compass rose with NO compass letters; SILVER frame, parchment and dark turquoise backdrop. Absolutely no X shape or cross marks, no writing or labels.
RIGHT square: Fan of THREE round colorful fantasy MEDALS with purple, gold and silver disks, each disk has only an unmistakable raised emblem (TWO CROSSED SWORDS on center gold, FIVE POINTED STAR on silver, LEAF on purple). Swallowtail ribbons hang DOWN below the disks, like purple medal reference. Absolutely NO rank numbers or numerals, no upright isolated sword, no typography. GOLD rounded square perimeter frame, dark blue backdrop, restrained glints. All three framed tiles same exact dimensions, filled edge to edge.
